name: housecraft
description: Model a single-level home and explore renovation ideas in a local 3D preview.

interface.longDescription: Give your coding agent floor plans, photos, or measurements to build an editable model of one single-level home. Label estimates, preserve the existing layout, and compare renovation variants in a localhost browser preview. Furniture appears as dimensioned boxes. HouseCraft needs desktop execution with Git, Node.js 22 or later, npm, and a WebGL browser. It uses the separate open-source HouseCraft Viewer and needs no HouseCraft account. Renovation concepts do not assess structural feasibility.
defaultPrompt: Set up HouseCraft and check whether my computer can run the local preview.
Model my single-level home from these measurements. Ask for missing dimensions and label estimates.
Add a variant with the dining table by the window and keep the existing layout unchanged.

publication.release_notes: First version of the local setup and home-modeling workflows, using HouseCraft Viewer v0.1.0 for validation and 3D previews.
